## What We Did
Covered logistic regression, spatial cross validation, and introduced the next assignment on predicting recidivism.

## Key Concepts
Geographic Cross Validation: accounts for spatial autocorrelation by clustering the test cells (leave one district out)

odds: how many times more likely it happens than doesn't happen; p/(1-p)
ex: p=0.455
0.455/(1-0.455) = 0.835
(for every 100 people not arrested, 84 are)

Logistic Regression predicts a binary outcome (0/1)
- logit link function

Confusion matrix: matrix between the predicted and actual values
      |    Actual 1    |    Actual 0    |
------|----------------|----------------|
True  | True Positive  | False Positive |
False | False Negative | True Negative  |

Sensitivity: true positives / (true positives + false negatives)

Specificity: true negatives / (true negatives + false positives)

Precision: true positives / all positives
